value.rationale: The three-row open cylinder is the smallest natural vertical width that supports the classical blinker mechanism. The exact all-circumference two-period and stationary power-sum formulas determine a genuine intrinsic dynamical comparison, not merely a finite table. Their different primitive Perron roots lie just 0.014 apart, producing a nonobvious rigorous exponential prevalence of temporal oscillation among all at-most-two-period states. The result is a precise reusable entropy benchmark, without asserting broader attractor classification or a paper-sized downstream consequence.
